दशनः,
 
-नम् [दंश् भावे करणादौ वा ल्युट् नि° नलेपः] 
__1 A tooth; मुहुर्मुहुर्दशनविखण्डितोष्ठया [[Śi. 17. 2]]; शिखरिदशना [[

.]] 
__2 Biting.

-नम् An armour (also m.). 
-Comp. 
-अंशुः brightness of the teeth; अथ मौलिगतस्येन्दोर्विशदैर्दशनांशुभिः (उपचिन्वन्) [[

.]]

-उच्छिष्टः 
__1 a lip. 
__2 a kiss. 
__3 a sigh. 
-छदः, -वासस् n. 
__1 a lip. 
__2 a kiss. 
-पदम् a bite, tooth-mark; दशनपदं भवदधरगतं मम जनयति चेतसि खेदम् [[

a. 
__1 Biting. 
__2 Noxious, hurtful. 
-रः A mischievous or venomous animal.

__1 A young camel. 
__2 An ass; यास्तिष्ठन्त्यः प्रमेहन्ति यथैवोष्ट्रदशेरकाः [[

__1 A young camel; see under दशन. 
__2 N. of a country; [[Bṛ.

.]] 
__2 The Mālava country.

p. p. Bitten, stung; see दंश्.
Num. a. (pl.) Ten; स भूमिं विश्वतो वृत्वा अत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम् [[

.]] 
__2 a water-melon. 
-अधिपतिः a commander of ten men. [[

.]] 
-अर्ध a. five, 
(-र्धम्) five; अण्व्यो मात्रा विनाशिन्यो दशार्धानां तु याः स्मृताः [[

.]] 
(-र्धः) an epithet of Buddha. 
-अर्हः 
__1 an epithet of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu. 
__2 Buddha. 
-अवताराः m. (pl.) the ten incarnations of Viṣṇu; see under अवतार. 
-अवर a. consisting of at least ten; दशावरा वा परिषद्यं धर्मं परिकल्पयेत् [[

.]] 
-अश्वः the moon. 
-आननः, -आस्यः epithets of Rāvaṇā; दशाननकिरीटेभ्यस्तत्क्षणं राक्षसप्रियः [[

.]] 
-आमयः an epithet of Rudra. 
-इन्द्रियाणि The five कर्मेन्द्रियs and five ज्ञानेन्द्रियs. 
-ईशः a superintendent of 10 villages; [[

.]] 
-एकादशिक a. who lends 10 and receives 11 in return; i. e. who lends money at ten per cent. 
-कण्ठः, -कन्धरः epithets of Rāvaṇa; सप्तलोकैकवीरस्य दशकण्ठकुलद्विषः [[
.]] °अरिः, °जित् m., °रिपुः epithets of Rāma; दशकण्ठारिगुरुं विदुर्बुधाः [[

.]] 
-कर्मन् n. the ten ceremonies prescribed to the three twice-born classes. 
-कुमारचरितम् a prose work by Daṇḍin. 
-क्षीर a. mixed with 10 parts of milk. 
-गुण a. ten-fold, ten times larger. 
-गुणित a. multiplied by 10; दशगुणितमिव प्राप्तवान् वीरधर्मम [[B.

.]] 
-प्रन्थाः (pl.) संहिता, ब्राह्मण, आरण्यक, शिक्षा, कल्प, व्याकरण, निघण्टु, छन्द and निरुक्त; hence दशग्रन्थिन् = A person who has learnt by heart all these ten books. 
-ग्रामपतिः, -ग्रामिकः, -ग्रामिन् m., 
-पः a superintendent of ten villages. 
-ग्रामी a collection or corporation of ten villages. 
-ग्रीवः = दशकण्ठ q. v. 
-चतुष्कम् N. of a sport; [[

.]] 
-धर्मः unfavourable condition, distress; अभ्यस्तो बहुभिर्बाणैर्दशधर्मगतेन वै [[

.]] (see com.). 
-पारमिताध्वरः ‘possessing the ten perfections’, an epithet of Buddha. 
-पुरम् N. of an ancient city, capital of king Rantideva; पात्रीकुर्वन्दशपुरवधूनेत्रकौतूहलानाम् [[

.]] 
-बलः, -भूमिगः epithets of Buddha. 
-बाहुः an epithet of Śiva. 
-भुजा, -महाविद्या N. of Durgā. 
-मालिकाः (pl.) 
__1 N. of a country. 
__2 the people or rulers of this country. 
-मास्य a. 
__1 ten months old; एवा ते गर्भ एजतु निरैतु दशमास्यः [[

-8.]] 
__2 ten months in the womb (as a child before birth). 
-मुखः an epithet of Rāvaṇa. °रिपुः an epithet of Rāma; सीतां हित्वा दशमुखरिपुर्नोपयेमे यदन्याम् [[

.]] 
-मूत्रकम् The urine of 10 (elephant, buffalo, camel, cow, goat, sheep, horse, donkey, man and woman). 
-मूलम् a tonic medicine prepared from the roots of ten plants; (Mar. सालवण, पिटवण (पृष्टिपर्णो), रिंगणी, डोरली, गोखरूं, बेल, ऐरण, टेंटू, पहाडमूळ, शिवण). 
-योजनम् a distance of 10 Yojanas; पादाङ्गुष्ठेन चिक्षेप संपूर्णं दशयोजनम् [[
]]; also दशयोजनी; मोहितेन्द्रियवृत्तिं तं व्यतीत्य दशयोजनीम् [[

.]] 
-रथः N. of a celebrated king of Ayodhyā, son of Aja, and father of Rāma and his three brothers. [He had three wives Kausalyā, Sumitrā, and Kaikeyī, but was for several years without issue. He was therefore [Page0805-2] recommended by Vasiṣṭha to perform a sacrifice which he successfully did with the assistance of Ṛṣyaśṛṅga. On the completion of this sacrifice Kausalyā bore to him Rāma, Sumitrā Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna, and Kaikeyī Bharata. Daśaratha was extremely fond of his sons, but Rāma was his greatest favourite -- ‘his life, his very soul.’ Thus when Kaikeyī at the instigation of Mantharā demanded the fulfilment of the two boons he had previously promised to her, the king tried to dissuade her mind from her wicked resolve by threats, and, failing these, by the most servile supplications. But Kaikeyī remained inexorable, and the poor monarch was obliged to send his beloved son into exile. He soon afterwards died of a broken heart]. [[

]] °ललिता The fourth day of the dark fortnight of Āśvina. 
-रशिमशतः the sun; दशरशिमशतोपमद्युतिम् [[

.]] 
-रात्रम् a period of ten nights. 
(-त्रः) a particular sacrifice lasting for ten days. 
-रूपकम् the 10 kinds of drama. 
-रूपभृत् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu. 
-लक्षण a. relating to 10 objects; इदं भागवतं पुराणं दक्षलक्षणम् [[

.]] 
-णम् ten marks or attributes. 
-लक्षणकः religion; cf. धृतिः क्षमा दमोऽस्तेयं शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः । धीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणम् ॥ [[

.]] 
-वर्गः the double five classes of अमात्य, राष्ट्र, दुर्ग, कोश and दण्ड; वेत्ता च दशवर्गस्य स्थानवृद्धिक्षयात्मनः [[

स्वपक्षे परपक्षे चेति दशको वर्गः). 
-वाजिन् m. the moon. 
-वार्षिक a. happening after, or lasting for, ten years; [[

.]] 
-विध a. of ten kinds. 
-शतम् 
__1 a thousand; ये सहस्रमराजन्नासन् दशशता उत [[

.]] 
__2 one hundred and ten. °रश्मिः the sun. °अक्षः, °नयनः Indra; दशशताक्षककुब्दरिनिःसृतः [[

.]] 
-शती a thousand. 
-स(सा)हस्रम् ten thousand. 
-हरा 
__1 an epithet of the Ganges (taking away the 10 sins). 
__2 a festival in honour of the Ganges held on the 10th day of Jyeṣṭha. 
__3 a festival in honour of Durgā held on the tenth of Āśvina.
a. Consisting of ten, tenfold; कामजो दशको गणः [[

.]]

f., दशतिः f. A group of ten, decad.

a.

ind.

n.

a. 
__1 Divided into ten parts. 
__2 Having ten. -m. A superintendent of ten villages.

]]; विषमां हि दशां प्राप्य दैवं गर्हयते नरः [[

.]]

दाशे(से)यः
The son of a fisherman's wife. 
-यी An epithet of Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa; समीक्ष्य राजा दाशेयीं कामयामास शान्तनुः [[
The son of a female slave.

दाशरथः,
 
-दाशरथिः

]]; अजीगणद्दाशरथं न वाक्यम् [[Bk.]]

]]; प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली [[Mahānāṭaka]]; यथा यथा दाशरथिर्धर्ममेवाश्रितोऽभवत् । तथा तथा प्रकृतयो रामं पतिमकामयन् ॥ [[Rām.]]
a. Belonging to ten kings. The battle of ten kings against king Sudāsa is often referred to in the Ṛgveda and is known as दाशराज्ञयुद्ध.
Probably an officer who collected fines for ten specified kinds of criminal offences.

__1 A female servant or slave. 
__2 The wife of a fisherman. 
__3 The wife of a Śūdra. 
__4 An altar.

-Comp. 
-पुत्रः, -सुतः the son of a female slave.

-सभम् a collection of female slaves. (The gen. sing. दास्याः enters into some compounds, but loses its literal sense; e. g. दास्याःपुत्रः, सुतः ‘a whore-son’, used as a term of abuse; [[
]]; दास्याःपुत्रैः शकुनिलुब्धकैः [[Ś. 2]]; but दास्याः सदृशी ‘like a female slave’).
Servitude, slavery, service, bondage; पतिकुले तव दास्यमपि क्षमम् [[Ś. 5. 27]]; [[
The first of the 27 lunar mansions.
